verdict.rationale: SCA routing is a fair question for a payment fraud-decisioning product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents a Pre-Auth Checkout fraud review and a generic 'Authorization Rate Optimization' claim. Nothing mentions 3DS triggering, SCA exemption requests, or European/PSD2 routing, so this is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, European traffic is routed intelligently through SCA — 3DS triggered when required or risky, exemptions requested when safe — to protect both compliance and conversion
